title: Student World · reparar posición responsive de Rutas José
mission: Repará el canary aislado Student World para que el offset del toggle Rutas José derive del ancho real del panel en vez de una fórmula divergente. Preservá click/Escape y autoridad CANDIDATE_NOT_CURRENT_NOT_SERVED; no promociones Current/Catalog/Served.
definition_of_done: El offset del toggle abierto deriva del ancho real del panel o de una única fuente CSS/DOM equivalente, sin constantes divergentes.
Una regresión determinista cubre 500px y 360px y demuestra que toggle y panel quedan alineados tras abrir y resize.
No se modifica ninguna autoridad Current, Catalog, Served o Human Accepted.
forbidden_scope: donor baseline mutation unless separately owned

target.capability: student world canary route rail responsive positioning

semantic_identity.problem: route toggle right offset diverges from actual route panel width across responsive breakpoints
acceptance: candidate-only authority is preserved and no current catalog served promotion occurs
chromium at 500px and 360px shows toggle flush with the route panel after open and resize
click and escape behavior remain passing
route toggle offset is derived from actual route panel width rather than a mismatched fixed formula

truth_boundary: Candidate repair only. Passing this job does not promote the canary or prove public-origin availability.
